milestones.title: Seek additional federal funding for Bachok’s infrastructure and local economy
milestones.description: Mohd Syahir committed to working with ministries and agencies to obtain more development funding for Bachok.
milestones.progress_note: The pledge names infrastructure, basic facilities and support for local economic activity. A comparable allocation target, resulting funding total and completed project set were not verified, so status and completion remain unknown.
